title: GSAP Small Examples
description: Use these small GSAP examples with the tools described in each lesson. Read the expected result before you try a change.

examples.title: Move to a new position
examples.description: A tween changes values over time. gsap.to starts from the current value and moves toward the value you give it.
examples.output: The box moves 120 CSS pixels to the right over one second.

examples.title: Start from a chosen value
examples.description: gsap.from starts with the supplied values and moves to the element's current values.
examples.output: The box appears from a slightly lower, transparent starting state.

examples.title: Set both ends explicitly
examples.description: fromTo names both the starting and ending values.
examples.output: The box moves from x=0 to x=100 while becoming fully visible.

examples.title: Choose an easing curve
examples.description: Easing changes the speed during a tween.
examples.output: The box moves quickly at first and slows as it reaches the end.

examples.title: Repeat and return
examples.description: repeat adds more plays after the first. yoyo reverses the direction on alternate plays.
examples.output: The box moves right once and then returns to its starting position.

examples.title: Sequence steps on a timeline
examples.description: A timeline groups tweens in order. By default, a new tween begins after the previous one finishes.
examples.output: The box moves, then turns, then fades partway.

examples.title: Overlap timeline steps
examples.description: A timeline position can make two tweens overlap.
examples.output: The box moves and turns at the same time.

examples.title: Stagger a group
examples.description: Stagger starts similar tweens at slightly different times.
examples.output: The three paragraphs appear one after another with a short gap between starts.

examples.title: Control playback
examples.description: A tween object has methods to play, pause and reverse.
examples.output: The box waits until the Play movement button is pressed.

examples.title: Respect reduced motion
examples.description: GSAP matchMedia can choose different motion based on a media query.
examples.output: People who allow motion get a short entrance. Those requesting less motion see the normal box directly.

examples.title: Clean up a component animation
examples.description: A GSAP context can collect animations created for a component.
examples.output: Cleanup reverts the tween's changes before removing its box.

examples.title: Animate transforms with a purpose
examples.description: Transform and opacity animations often avoid redoing page layout.
examples.output: The box briefly grows and returns, using its transform rather than changing its layout width.
